revision: Revision 2: added Reset progress button and Next up panel (first 5 unearned story trophies); roadmap story count corrected from 12 to 14.

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies. It pops as soon as the last one lands, so work the list in order: story first, then side strands, then collectibles and the grinds.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Story, unmissable. Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, and the trophy pops at the mission results screen.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Story, unmissable. Play through Chapter 1 to its end; no side content is needed for this one.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Story, unmissable. Finish every mission in Chapter 2 and the trophy pops when the chapter closes.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Story, unmissable. Clear Chapter 3's missions in order; the trophy is awarded at the chapter's end.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Story, unmissable. Finish Chapter 4 and the trophy pops at the chapter close.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Story, unmissable. Beat the final mission and the credits roll with this gold trophy. Save before the finale if you want to mop up afterwards.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Story, unmissable. Complete the mission Breakfast Run when it appears in the story; it pops at the mission results screen.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Story, unmissable. Finish The Cartel Heist mission; the trophy is awarded on completion.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Story, unmissable. Complete the mission Child's Play when the story brings it up.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Story, unmissable. Finish the Headliners mission to earn it.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Story, unmissable. Complete the VCIA Takedown mission.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Story, unmissable. Finish Operation Savage Glory and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The 100% trophy. Clear the story, all side strands, every collectible set and every activity the checklist tracks, then check the in-game stats for what is left; this is the last gold most players earn.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Grind, best done while exploring: land 250 stunt jumps. Ramps and raised edges around Vice City count; keep a fast bike handy and jump whenever you see a ramp, and the total adds up across the whole playthrough.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample everything once: one race, one fishing trip, one arcade game, one shooting range round, one drone race and so on. The in-game activities menu shows which types you have tried.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: At the shooting range, earn gold on every challenge. Take your time on the aim drills, use a steady weapon you know, and replay a challenge as many times as needed; medals are per challenge, not per visit.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win one Top Fun drone race at each of its locations. Learn each course's racing line first, then race to win; the tracker in this guide lists the locations once you have visited them.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races across the race types. Vary the events instead of replaying one: street races, off-road and water races all count toward the 20, and a win is a win no matter the vehicle class.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Take the fishing challenge against Cal and beat his catch. Fish where the challenge says, reel steadily instead of yanking, and retry the challenge if he out-fishes you the first time.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Find an arcade cabinet and finish one full game on it. Any cabinet counts; pick the game you are best at and see it through to its end screen.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Side strand. Follow Andy's missions to their last one and complete it; stranger strands appear on the map as you progress the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Side strand. Complete Kenton's mission chain through to its final mission.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Side strand. Finish Billy's missions, ending with his final mission.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: The stranger-strand silver. Complete 8 full stranger mission chains across Leonida, including the ones for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone; each chain ends with a trophy of its own, so this one follows naturally.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Side strand. Complete Randy's mission chain through to its final mission.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Side strand. Complete Tyrone's mission chain through to its final mission.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Collectible. Meditate at every meditation spot in Leonida; the spots are marked once you find them, so sweep the map region by region and tick each off in this guide.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Side strand. Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for; it only appears in its own spot, so follow Bret's directions in his mission rather than hunting at random.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Collectible. Finish 3 full collectible card sets; cards are scattered across Leonida, so pick up every one you pass and trade the checklist here to see which sets are close to complete.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Grind. Use WAiNK It at 100 different locations. It adds up fast if you do it every time you pass a new spot instead of leaving it for the end; the count is per location, so repeats do not help.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Grind. Complete 50 challenges of any kind; they stack across activities, so the races, stunts and shooting challenges you do for other trophies count toward this one too.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside, build a 4-star wanted level, then break line of sight and stay out of the search area until the heat drops. Rural roads and water help more than the city centre.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row without the wanted level dropping between them. Plan a route past three shops, keep the getaway car close, and do not stop to fight the police.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Collectible. Discover 100 different vehicles; every new vehicle you drive counts, so hop into anything unfamiliar you pass and the total climbs on its own.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: In one Combat Focus, take down 5 enemies. Trigger it only when a group is clustered in front of you, aim for the closest first, and do not waste it on a single target.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Missable moment: at Vice City International Airport, leave by an unscheduled route instead of the normal one. Do it when the story takes you through VCIA; if the moment has passed, replay the mission from the pause menu.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Missable moment: get into a Rhino tank and make use of it while you have the chance. It is tied to a specific mission moment, so grab the Rhino when it appears rather than driving past it.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without tripping the alarm or being spotted. Go in quiet, move fast, and leave before the police are called; a failed attempt can be retried from the mission replay.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape each time. Plan the getaway before you go in, and treat each vault as its own job; the count carries across the whole playthrough.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Stop an armored truck, rob it, and escape the police afterwards. Block it on a quiet road, grab the cash fast, and have a fast car waiting.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Collectible. Explore every region of Leonida until the map is fully revealed. Drive the highways, visit each town, and check the map for dark patches you have not covered yet.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation from each gang in Leonida. Each gang's operations sit in its own territory, so work through the gangs one at a time and tick them off here.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Missable moment: have a cocktail at the Ocean Beach spot with the view. Do it when you are on Ocean Beach; the spot is a one-off visit, so do not rush past it.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Missable moment: smash your way out of a vehicle showroom, the classic way, when the story gives you the chance. Drive through the glass, not the door, and do it while the mission is live.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Missable moment: play through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley when the story takes you there. Finish the frame instead of walking away mid-game.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Missable moment: build the partnership's appeal as high as it goes when the chance comes. It is tied to a specific story beat, so engage with it fully while it is available.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Missable moment: a story choice. The trophy pops for the choice you make, so if you want the other outcome, replay the mission from the pause menu and choose differently.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Missable moment: do the thing a second time. It pops on the retry, so if the first attempt passed without it, replay the mission and do it again.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Missable moment: an odd event in the open world. Keep an eye out for the strange encounter this trophy is named for; it only happens once, in one place.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Missable moment: from a moving vehicle, knock the pins over with a melee attack. Line the car up with the alley, swing as you pass, and retry from the mission replay if you miss.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Grind. Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Pick up Marked Bills from robberies and jobs, then move them through contacts regularly instead of hoarding them.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Grind. Spend $100,000 across the shops of Leonida. Weapons, clothes and vehicle upgrades all count, so spend as you play rather than saving it all for the end.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Collectible. Buy every garage property in Leonida. Save up through the story, then buy the remaining garages in one sweep; the property menu shows which ones you still lack.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Any vehicle you own can be registered, so register each new one as soon as you get it.
trophies.name: On the Spot
